q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a pocket spring mattress?
title: Pocket spring mattress carbon footprint
short: Weigh the steel springs, foam layers, fabric and non-woven per mattress and multiply by supplier figures. Add spring coiling, pocketing, quilting and assembly energy, then divide the plant's energy by mattresses made.

ul: Ticking fabric, non-woven pocket fabric and adhesive.
Coiling springs and sealing them in non-woven pockets.

p: Report per mattress by size and weight. Foam and steel usually make up most of the footprint.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per mattress (one month)
lines: Plant total: 42,600 / 6,000 = 7.100 kg CO2 per mattress
Add spring wire, foam and fabric for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
